```{=html}
<style>
  .quarto-title-meta { display: none; }

  .description { margin-bottom: 0 !important; }
  #quiz-app { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1.15rem; }

  #quiz-app .btn-lg { font-size: 1.25rem; }

    min-height: 180px; width: 100%; white-space: normal;

    background-color: #2b3e50; color: #ffffff;
    transition: border-color 0.3s, background-color 0.1s;
    cursor: pointer; user-select: text; -webkit-user-select: text;
  }
  .quiz-btn:hover { border-color: #14549e; background-color: #1a2a3a; color: #ffffff; }
  .quiz-btn .activity-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.3; }
  .quiz-btn .badge { font-size: 0.85em; }
  .quiz-btn-correct { border: 3px solid #198754 !important; background-color: #d1e7dd !important; color: #0f5132 !important; cursor: default; }
  .quiz-btn-wrong { border: 3px solid #dc3545 !important; background-color: #f8d7da !important; color: #842029 !important; cursor: default; }
  .quiz-btn-neutral { border: 3px solid #6c757d !important; background-color: #e9ecef !important; color: #495057 !important; cursor: default; }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    #quiz-app { padding: 10px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
```

```{=html}

<script>
// ---- State ----
const S = {
  phase: 'instructions', nQuestions: 5, currentQ: 0,
  pairs: [], answers: [], displayOrder: [], revealed: [],
  selDifficulty: 'mixed', selNq: 5, seenKeys: new Set()
};
let quizPool = [];

// ---- Data ----
function loadData() {
  const el = document.getElementById('quiz-data');
  if (!el) return;
  quizPool = JSON.parse(el.textContent);
}

// ---- Security helpers ----
function escHtml(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
    return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
  });
}
function safeHref(u) {
  u = String(u || '');
  if (/^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|\/|#)/i.test(u)) return u;
  return '#';
}

// ---- Helpers ----
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = [...arr];
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function formatName(name) { return name.replace(/\s*\(/, '<br>('); }
function fmtML(v) {
  const dir = v >= 0 ? '+' : '';
  const abs = Math.abs(v);
  if (abs >= 10) return dir + Math.round(abs);
  return dir + parseFloat(abs.toFixed(1));
}
function fmtMLabs(v) {
  if (v >= 10) return Math.round(v).toString();
  return parseFloat(v.toFixed(1)).toString();
}
function renderQR(containerId, size) {
  const url = window.location.href.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
  const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!el || typeof qrcode === 'undefined') return;
  const safeSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, parseInt(size, 10) || 3));
  const qr = qrcode(0, 'M');
  qr.addData(url);
  qr.make();
  const img = qr.createImgTag(safeSize);
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'qr-section';
  wrapper.innerHTML = img;
  const urlSpan = document.createElement('span');
  urlSpan.className = 'qr-url';
  urlSpan.textContent = url;
  wrapper.appendChild(urlSpan);
  el.innerHTML = '';
  el.appendChild(wrapper);
}
function selectInGroup(grpId, clicked) {
  const btns = document.getElementById(grpId).querySelectorAll('.option-btn');
  btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  clicked.classList.add('selected');
}

// ---- Leaderboard (pure JS) ----
const FORM_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1HX5kPVO6G982zOxH2BLv1FWexiITPnbjfWMN3a1M9yDtvw/formResponse';
const SHEET_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17HLtIdV3r55dIh06cSaWT8kFXzNrkR-Fu2ZJkjszG8k/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json';
const STATS_URL = 'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/api/quiz_stats.json';
let scoreSubmitted = false;

function resetLeaderboard() {
  scoreSubmitted = false;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Score'; btn.className = 'btn btn-lg'; btn.style.cssText = 'background:#b85c0a;color:#fff'; }
  const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  if (el) el.textContent = '';
}

function submitScore(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions) {
  if (scoreSubmitted) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Submitting...'; btn.className = 'btn btn-secondary btn-lg'; }
  const data = new URLSearchParams();
  data.append('entry.335579146', score);
  data.append('entry.2122920576', total);
  data.append('entry.621716914', new Date().toISOString());
  data.append('entry.268026248', 'chronic');
  data.append('entry.232879816', difficulty || '');
  data.append('entry.2010782223', nQuestions || '');
  fetch(FORM_URL, {method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', body: data}).then(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Submitted!'; btn.className = 'btn btn-success btn-lg'; }
    getPercentile(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions);
  }).catch(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Score saved locally'; btn.className = 'btn btn-info btn-lg'; }
  });
}

function interpolatePercentile(scorePct, group) {
  const p = group.percentiles, s = group.scores_pct;
  for (let i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (scorePct >= s[i]) return p[i]; }
  return 0;
}

function getPercentile(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions) {
  const pct = score / total * 100;
  fetch(STATS_URL).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
  .then(stats => {
    const d = stats.chronic;
    let msg = 'You scored better than ' + interpolatePercentile(pct, d.overall) + '% of all players';
    const key = (difficulty || 'mixed') + '_' + (nQuestions || 5);
    const sub = d.by_config[key];
    if (sub && sub.n >= 10) msg += ' (' + interpolatePercentile(pct, sub) + '% of ' + difficulty + '/' + nQuestions + 'Q players)';
    msg += '! (' + d.overall.n + ' submissions)';
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = msg;
  }).catch(() => {
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'Loading rankings...';
    fetch(SHEET_URL).then(r => r.text()).then(text => {
      const json = JSON.parse(text.replace(/.*google\.visualization\.Query\.setResponse\(/, '').replace(/\);$/, ''));
      let below = 0;
      json.table.rows.forEach(row => {
        const s = row.c[0] ? row.c[0].v : 0, t = row.c[1] ? row.c[1].v : 10;
        if ((s / t * 100) < pct) below++;
      });
      const percentile = json.table.rows.length > 0 ? Math.round(below / json.table.rows.length * 100) : 50;
      if (el) el.textContent = 'You scored better than ' + percentile + '% of players! (' + json.table.rows.length + ' submissions)';
    }).catch(() => { if (el) el.textContent = 'Score submitted! Rankings unavailable right now.'; });
  });
}

// ---- Result phrases ----
const PHRASES = [
  {min: 95, phrase: 'Longevity expert!', fact: 'A microlife equals 30 minutes of life expectancy.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microlife'},
  {min: 90, phrase: 'You think in microlives!', fact: 'David Spiegelhalter introduced microlives to communicate chronic risk.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microlife'},
  {min: 80, phrase: 'Impressive health literacy!', fact: 'Most people underestimate the effect of everyday habits on lifespan.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Health_literacy'},
  {min: 70, phrase: 'Better than average!', fact: 'Exercise is one of the most effective longevity interventions known.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exercise#Health_effects'},
  {min: 60, phrase: 'Getting there!', fact: 'Gains from healthy habits can partially offset losses from unhealthy ones.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Healthy_diet'},
  {min: 50, phrase: 'About average!', fact: 'Many chronic risk factors interact, making individual effects hard to estimate.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_factor'},
  {min: 30, phrase: 'Surprises everywhere!', fact: 'Small daily habits compound over years into large effects on life expectancy.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Life_expectancy'},
  {min: -1, phrase: 'Room to learn!', fact: 'Understanding risk helps you make better decisions about your health.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_communication'}
];
function getPhrase(pct) { return PHRASES.find(p => pct >= p.min) || PHRASES[PHRASES.length - 1]; }

const ENCOURAGEMENTS = [
  "30 minutes of life expectancy per microlife. Choose wisely.",
  "Your daily habits are quietly writing your life story.",
  "Think you know which choices matter most? Prove it.",
  "Every day is a longevity experiment. How's yours going?",
  "Side effects may include sudden urge to eat more vegetables.",
  "Some habits give you time. Others take it away.",
  "Spoiler: your lifestyle choices matter more than you think.",
  "Statistically, this quiz will be good for you. Probably."
];

// ---- Render functions ----
function render() {
  const app = document.getElementById('quiz-app');
  switch (S.phase) {
    case 'instructions': app.innerHTML = renderInstructions(); renderQR('qr-instructions', 3); break;
    case 'question': app.innerHTML = renderQuestion(); break;
    case 'results_summary': app.innerHTML = renderResults(); renderQR('qr-results', 3); break;
    case 'results_detail': app.innerHTML = renderDetail(); break;
  }
}

function renderInstructions() {
  const enc = ENCOURAGEMENTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ENCOURAGEMENTS.length)];
  return `
    <div class="card"><div class="card-body">
      <ul class="mb-1">
        <li>Each question shows <b><em>two daily habits or lifestyle factors</em></b>.</li>
        <li>Tap the factor with the <b><em>bigger effect on lifespan</em></b>.</li>
        <li>You can <b><em>skip</em></b> questions or go <b><em>back</em></b> and review previous answers.</li>
        <li>Skipped (unanswered) questions score zero.</li>
        <li>A <b><em>microlife (ml)</em></b> = 30 minutes of life expectancy per day.</li>
        <li>Factors can be <b>harmful (−)</b> or <b>beneficial (+)</b>.</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="mb-1" style="padding-left:1.5em;"><em>${enc}</em></div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label">Difficulty</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_diff">
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='easy';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Easy</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='medium';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Medium</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='hard';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Hard</button>
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selDifficulty='mixed';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Mixed</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label">Questions</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_nq">
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selNq=5;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">5</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selNq=10;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">10</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-center mt-3">
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="startQuiz()">Start Quiz</button>
      </div>
      <div id="qr-instructions"></div>
    </div></div>`;
}

function startQuiz() {
  let pool = S.selDifficulty !== 'mixed'
    ? quizPool.filter(p => p.difficulty === S.selDifficulty)
    : [...quizPool];

  // Exclude seen pairs
  pool = pool.filter(p => {
    const key = [p.factor_a, p.factor_b].sort().join('|||');
    return !S.seenKeys.has(key);
  });
  if (pool.length < S.selNq) { S.seenKeys.clear(); pool = S.selDifficulty !== 'mixed' ? quizPool.filter(p => p.difficulty === S.selDifficulty) : [...quizPool]; }

  const n = Math.min(S.selNq, pool.length);
  S.nQuestions = n;
  S.pairs = shuffle(pool).slice(0, n);
  S.pairs.forEach(p => S.seenKeys.add([p.factor_a, p.factor_b].sort().join('|||')));
  S.answers = new Array(n).fill(null);
  S.displayOrder = S.pairs.map(() => Math.random() < 0.5 ? ['a','b'] : ['b','a']);
  S.revealed = new Array(n).fill(false);
  S.currentQ = 0;
  S.phase = 'question';
  render();
}

function renderQuestion() {
  const q = S.currentQ, n = S.nQuestions, pair = S.pairs[q];
  const ord = S.displayOrder[q], revealed = S.revealed[q], answer = S.answers[q];
  const L = ord[0], R = ord[1];

  function side(s) {
    return {
      factor: pair['factor_' + s], category: pair['category_' + s],
      ml: pair['microlives_' + s], direction: pair['direction_' + s],
      annual_days: pair['annual_days_' + s],
      desc: pair['description_' + s], help: pair['help_url_' + s]
    };
  }
  const left = side(L), right = side(R);

  function btnClass(s, isMore) {
    if (!revealed) return 'quiz-btn';
    if (isMore) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-correct';
    if (answer === s) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-wrong';
    return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-neutral';
  }
  const leftMore = Math.abs(left.ml) > Math.abs(right.ml);
  const rightMore = Math.abs(right.ml) > Math.abs(left.ml);

  function btnContent(d, s, cls) {
    const dirBadge = d.direction === 'gain'
      ? '<span class="badge bg-success">gain</span>'
      : '<span class="badge bg-danger">lose</span>';
    const mlText = revealed ? `<strong style="font-size:1.4rem;color:#333;">${fmtML(d.ml)} ml/day</strong>` : '';
    const helpLink = d.help ? `<a class="help-link" href="${escHtml(safeHref(d.help))}" target="_blank" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">Learn more &rarr;</a>` : '';
    const clickAttr = revealed ? '' : `onclick="choose('${s}')"`;
    return `<div class="${cls}" ${clickAttr}>
      <span class="activity-name">${formatName(escHtml(d.factor))}</span>
      <div><span class="badge bg-secondary me-1">${escHtml(d.category)}</span>${dirBadge}</div>
      ${mlText}${helpLink}
    </div>`;
  }

  // Result text
  let resultHtml = '';
  if (revealed) {
    const correct = pair.answer;
    const userCorrect = answer === correct;
    if (answer === null) {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger text-center mt-2 py-2">Skipped! ${escHtml(pair['factor_' + correct])} has a bigger effect.</div>`;
    } else if (userCorrect) {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-success text-center mt-2 py-2"><strong>Correct!</strong></div>`;
    } else {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger text-center mt-2 py-2"><strong>Incorrect!</strong> ${escHtml(pair['factor_' + correct])} has a bigger effect.</div>`;
    }
    // Explanation
    const bigger = pair.answer, smaller = bigger === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a';
    const biggerAnnual = pair['annual_days_' + bigger];
    const smallerAnnual = pair['annual_days_' + smaller];
    const annualBigger = biggerAnnual ? ` (${Math.abs(Math.round(biggerAnnual * 365))} days/year)` : '';
    const annualSmaller = smallerAnnual ? ` (${Math.abs(Math.round(smallerAnnual * 365))} days/year)` : '';
    resultHtml += `<div class="explanation-panel mt-2">
      <p><strong>${escHtml(pair['factor_' + bigger])}</strong> ${pair['direction_' + bigger] === 'gain' ? 'gains' : 'loses'} ${fmtMLabs(Math.abs(pair['microlives_' + bigger]))} ml/day${annualBigger}: ${escHtml(pair['description_' + bigger] || '')}</p>
      <p><strong>${escHtml(pair['factor_' + smaller])}</strong> ${pair['direction_' + smaller] === 'gain' ? 'gains' : 'loses'} ${fmtMLabs(Math.abs(pair['microlives_' + smaller]))} ml/day${annualSmaller}: ${escHtml(pair['description_' + smaller] || '')}</p>
      <p>${escHtml(pair['factor_' + bigger])} has ${pair.ratio.toFixed(1)}x the effect of ${escHtml(pair['factor_' + smaller])}.</p>
    </div>`;
  }

  // Tally
  let correctSoFar = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= q; i++) { if (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) correctSoFar++; }
  const answered = S.revealed.filter(Boolean).length;

  const diffBadge = (() => {
    const d = pair.difficulty;
    if (!d) return '';
    const colors = {easy:'background:#198754;color:#fff', medium:'background:#b85c0a;color:#fff', hard:'background:#dc3545;color:#fff'};
    const style = colors[d] || 'background:#6c757d;color:#fff';
    return `<span class="badge me-2" style="${style}">${escHtml(d)}</span>`;
  })();

  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="prevQ()">&larr; Back</button>
      <span class="text-muted">${diffBadge}${q+1} of ${n} &middot; <small>Score: ${correctSoFar}/${answered} correct</small></span>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="nextQ()">${q === n-1 ? 'Finish' : 'Next &rarr;'}</button>
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-row">
      <div class="quiz-col">${btnContent(left, L, btnClass(L, L === pair.answer))}</div>
      <div class="quiz-vs"><h3 class="text-muted mb-0">VS</h3></div>
      <div class="quiz-col">${btnContent(right, R, btnClass(R, R === pair.answer))}</div>
    </div>
    ${resultHtml}`;
}

function choose(side) {
  S.answers[S.currentQ] = side;
  S.revealed[S.currentQ] = true;
  render();
}
function nextQ() {
  if (S.currentQ < S.nQuestions - 1) { S.currentQ++; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'results_summary'; render(); }
}
function prevQ() {
  if (S.currentQ > 0) { S.currentQ--; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'instructions'; render(); }
}

function renderResults() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let score = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) score++; }
  const pct = score / n * 100, baseline = (n / 2).toFixed(1);
  const info = getPhrase(pct);

  return `
    <h2 class="text-center mb-4">Results</h2>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-primary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Your Score</small><h2 class="mb-0">${score} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-secondary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Random Guessing</small><h2 class="mb-0">~${baseline} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mb-4">
      <h3>${info.phrase}</h3>
      <em>${info.fact}</em><br>
      <a href="${info.link}" target="_blank">Learn more &rarr;</a>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center gap-3">
      <button id="submit_btn" class="btn btn-lg" style="background:#b85c0a;color:#fff" onclick="submitScore(${score},${n},'${S.selDifficulty}',${S.selNq})">Submit Score</button>
      <button id="share_btn" class="btn btn-success btn-lg" onclick="shareResult(${score},${n})">Share</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-lg" onclick="S.phase='results_detail';render()">View Details</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small id="percentile_text" class="text-muted"></small><br>
      <small class="text-muted">Scores are recorded anonymously (score, total, timestamp only).</small>
    </div>
    <div id="qr-results"></div>`;
}

function shareResult(score, n) {
  const pEl = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  const pLine = pEl && pEl.textContent ? '\n' + pEl.textContent + '\n' : '\n';
  const text = '\u23f3 Microlife Quiz: I scored ' + score + '/' + n + '!' + pLine +
    'Which daily habit has a bigger effect on your lifespan?\n' +
    'Can you beat my score? \u23f3\n' +
    'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/articles/microlife-quiz.html';
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('share_btn');
    btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Share'; }, 2000);
  });
}

function renderDetail() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let rows = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = S.pairs[i], ans = S.answers[i];
    const userAns = ans === null ? 'Skipped' : escHtml(p['factor_' + ans]);
    const correctAns = escHtml(p['factor_' + p.answer]);
    const result = ans === null ? '\u2014' : (ans === p.answer ? '\u2713' : '\u2717');
    const linkA = p.help_url_a ? `<a href="${escHtml(safeHref(p.help_url_a))}" target="_blank">${escHtml(p.factor_a)}</a>` : escHtml(p.factor_a);
    const linkB = p.help_url_b ? `<a href="${escHtml(safeHref(p.help_url_b))}" target="_blank">${escHtml(p.factor_b)}</a>` : escHtml(p.factor_b);
    rows += `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${linkA}</td><td>${fmtML(p.microlives_a)}</td>
      <td>${linkB}</td><td>${fmtML(p.microlives_b)}</td>
      <td>${userAns}</td><td>${correctAns}</td><td>${result}</td></tr>`;
  }
  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="S.phase='results_summary';render()">&larr; Back to Results</button>
      <h3 class="mb-0">Your quiz details</h3>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-scroll">
      <table class="table table-striped table-hover detail-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Q</th><th>Factor A</th><th>ml/day A</th><th>Factor B</th><th>ml/day B</th><th>Your Answer</th><th>Correct</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
}

// ---- Init ----
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  loadData();
  render();
});
</script>
```
